market_summary: Across all six asset classes, the market is traversing a quiet late New York session consolidation following earlier aggressive trends. Equities (US100) are digesting gains in a Positive Dampening GEX regime between Call Wall 28429 and Put Wall 28300 above VWAP, while metals (XAUUSD, XAGUSD), FX pairs (EURUSD, GBPUSD), and BTCUSD are in low-volume post-trend pauses below their respective session VWAP and Value Area Lows. With RVOL sub-1.0 across the board and no fresh breakout catalysts, discipline dictates holding cash until new liquidity enters.

signals.rationale: Price is below VAL (3893.78) and POC (3978.13), trading well below downward-sloping VWAP (3933.36) and EMA50 (3914.54). In NEW_YORK_SESSION, Cumulative Delta is -7.38 (BEARISH), aligning with the overall downtrend but with a slight positive slope (+0.9) reflecting consolidation off the Session Low (3852.35). GEX regime is POSITIVE_DAMPENING with price hovering just above Gamma Flip (3869.70) while Put Wall #1 sits at 3819.50 and Call Wall #1 at 4146.89. ATR bands show volatility contracting with price positioned mid-channel, and RVOL is low at 0.788 without yellow volume spikes in 17 bars. Lacking expansion volume or clean rejection, HOLD is favored.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish, price holding well below downward sloping VWAP

signals.rationale: Price is trading above VAH (28244.33) and POC (28122.95), situated comfortably above ascending VWAP (28177.99) and EMA50 (28230.63). In NEW_YORK_SESSION, CVD reads +2.05 (NEUTRAL) with flat slope (+0.13).
